# Live GTFS-RT connector — check (auto-generated by scripts/16_gtfsrt_check.py)

Raw GPS of **27 Oct 2026, 17:00–18:30 IST** replayed as a GTFS-RT VehiclePositions feed: every **15 s**, the latest position of every bus (what a live feed sends). The connector (`app/gtfsrt.py`) decodes it, measures stop-to-stop runs with the same code as the historical pipeline (`app/gpsproc.py`), and the live window (last 15 min) is compared with the offline pipeline's runs for the same minutes, which saw every fix after the fact.

| time (IST) | stretches with live data (connector) | stretches (offline) | in both | median difference of the 15-min median run | within 10 % | correlation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 17:30 | 4,376 | 4,399 | 4,341 | 0.8 % | 85.5 % | 0.998 |
| 17:45 | 4,460 | 4,487 | 4,431 | 0.7 % | 85.6 % | 0.997 |
| 18:00 | 4,336 | 4,362 | 4,303 | 0.0 % | 88.0 % | 0.998 |

| 18:30 | 4,186 | 4,197 | 4,147 | 1.1 % | 83.4 % | 0.998 |

Feed: median 224 KB per poll, 5,838 buses in the 20-min buffer. Processing per poll: median 439 ms, p95 590 ms (this PC). Runs emitted: 135,256.

official bindings: our encoder → theirs OK; theirs → our decoder OK

Switch it on: `BUSPULSE_GTFSRT_URL=<VehiclePositions URL>` (+ `BUSPULSE_GTFSRT_HEADERS="x-api-key: …"`). `/health` then reports polls, buses and runs; `live=true` on `/journeys` blends the last 15 minutes with history.
